title: Withdraw an assertion while preserving its original revision
preconditions: Create code-scoped deprecation code with one r1 revision and active event.

steps.action: Append withdrawal with explicit active event parent and query history.
steps.expected_result: State is withdrawn; history contains both lifecycle events and the original revision.

steps.action: Compare the original assertion before and after withdrawal in the repository fixture.
steps.expected_result: The original revision bytes are unchanged.

expected_result: The original revision bytes are unchanged.
